verdict.rationale: Rive is a design and animation editor with an MCP integration and agent workflows, so an isolated sandbox for agent testing is a fair question. However, the evidence documents no sandbox, staging or test environment separate from production. Revision history ([rive-docs-12], [rive-docs-17], [rive-docs-29]) offers non-destructive rollback and copies of past revisions, but that is undo/versioning after the fact, not an isolated place to test.
